title: THE KING OF GLORY
ENTERS YOUR NIGHT
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: If anxiety keeps you awake tonight, heavy doors are opening before you.
Psalm twenty-four declares: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors;
and the King of glory shall come in. Who is this King of glory?
The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory.
Lord, enter our quiet room and fight the battles we cannot win alone. Subscribe to stand in prayer with us nightly.
